body.name: Path-retaining numeric-history baseline
body.construction: At layer \(i\), \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{num}}\) stores the complete numeric prefixes \(x^w_{\leq i}\) for every \(w\in\mathcal H\) together with the current conjunction flag. It expands every feasible numeric next column, immediately discards a path only when it violates a factual or query pin, and merges paths only when their complete stored numeric histories and flags are identical.
